note: Small primitive Custer Gallatin NF campground (Ashland RD), ~15 mi north of Ashland: east on US 212 for 6 mi, then northeast ~10 mi on E. Fork Otter Creek Rd. Some sites/largest spur to ~30 ft. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated May 1, 2026): confirmed free, 3 sites, no potable water; added season year-round (weather dependent). Vault toilet (derived) left: the page contradicts itself (accessible toilet listed, 'Restrooms are not available'). FCFS and 10-day limit (derived) not stated on the page, left. No alert for the campground or its road. Phone matches the Ashland RD (406-784-2344).
